mapper.sql: id, parent_id, name, name_en, code, type, label_type, energy, stage, apply_number, tagged_corpus, enable, source, seriousness, description, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT g4.id, g1.name as firstDimensionName, g1.NAME_EN as firstDimensionNameEn, g1.code as firstDimensionCode, g1.id as firstId, g2.name as secondDimensionName, g2.NAME_EN as secondDimensionNameEn, g2.code as secondDimensionCode, g2.id as secondId, g3.name as thirdDimensionName, g3.NAME_EN as thirdDimensionNameEn, g3.code as thirdDimensionCode, g3.id as thirdId, g4.name, g4.NAME_EN as nameEn, g4.code as code, g4.enable as enable, g4.source, g4.seriousness, g4.description, g4.label_type as labelType FROM ins_tag_info g4 LEFT JOIN ins_tag_info g3 ON g4.parent_id = g3.ID LEFT JOIN ins_tag_info g2 ON g3.parent_id = g2.ID LEFT JOIN ins_tag_info g1 ON g2.parent_id = g1.ID WHERE g4.id = #{id}
select tag_name as name,tag_code as code,tag_parent_id as parentId,id from ins_tag_info
